notes: Company overview: mid-to-high volume online marketplace selling home + lifestyle products. Heavy seasonality (BF/Cyber & holiday Nov-Dec, peak 6-10x traffic).
Search stack today: Algolia (front), Pinecone (personalization), Postgres for facet filtering. Duplicate indices and cross-service latency causing inconsistent rankings.
Primary goal: unify semantic search + reranking to reduce query cost and improve conversion (focus on margin-aware reranking).
Scale targets: want POC at 5M vectors; long-term index expected 8-12M SKUs and nightly refresh + realtime patching for availability/price changes.
Latency targets: 95th percentile <= 120ms for search+rerank under normal traffic, <= 250ms under 4x burst. 50ms expectation for pure embedding lookup if possible.
Cost sensitivity: current total cost/query (Algolia + Pinecone) ~ $0.015; finance target <$0.01 and ops target ~$0.002 after optimization.
Reranking needs: two-stage pipeline — candidate retrieval via dense embeddings, then lightweight transformer reranker that incorporates margin, stock, seller rating.
Data & freshness: weekly full re-index, hourly delta updates; some SKU attributes (price/stock) require sub-minute patching — important for reranker signals.
Security/compliance: SSO (SAML), enterprise KMS for keys, audit logs for query traces, data residency in NA and EU for EU customers.
Deployment preference: VPC-hosted Dedicated or Redwood Private (customer leaning toward VPC-first to maintain network controls).
Quote from head of search: 'We need predictable unit economics for Black Friday — last year our cost exploded and latency spiked.'
Product constraints: must support attribute-weighted reranking rules (business rules) and fallback to cheaper model variants when capacity constrained.
ML/engineering notes: they already train proprietary product-title embeddings (512 dim), open to Redwood running embeddings + storage or bringing embeddings in via batch imports.
Evaluation metrics requested: recall@50, MRR, rerank lift on CTR, p95 latency, cost per 1k queries, cold-start latency for new SKUs.
Technical concerns: KV cache TTLs for prefix caching, shard placement under multi-az, quantized model support for memory-limited nodes.
Procurement: procurement requires a 12-month commitment for Dedicated discounts; finance needs a modeled cost comparison for hosted vs dedicated vs private.
SE asks: produce a trial config that shows batching effects and caching saving on cost/q; sample dashboard mock for cost and latency per route.
Integration hooks: wants webhooks for index updates, S3 ingestion support, and tracing hooks (OpenTelemetry) into their observability.
Short-term wins: reduce duplicate indices, merge candidate store & reranker to avoid network hop, tune quantization to cut memory footprint 2-3x.
POC success criteria (customer): <=120ms p95, cost/q <= $0.007 at baseline, rerank CTR lift >= 6%, index freshness SLA (hourly deltas).
